description:
Who has called the account's agents, newest first, one record per person per agent: by Google sign-in, app account, phone number or browser. Each has a name, email and phone when the caller gave them, verified_by (google, app, form, or null), their latest location and platform, call_count, and whether they are blocked. Filter by agent_id, or set blocked to true for an agent's blocklist. For one caller's calls, use list_calls with caller_id.

Requires scope `calls:read`.

blocked.description: true for the blocklist, false for callers who are not blocked.

ending_before.description: Cursor from a previous response. Fetches the page before it. Not with starting_after.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Fetches the page after it.

name: list_callers
title: List callers
